Subject: Re: Vendor registration / PO linking for upcoming pilot (Stello - Redwood)

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and the form.

Quick answers up front:
- We require the PO number to be present on the invoice's top header and in the filename (PO12345_RedwoodInvoice.pdf). A PO reflected in the invoice body and filename helps our reconciliation team match payments to contracts.
- PDF naming: please include PO number + invoice date (YYYYMMDD). Example: PO12345_20261130_RedwoodInvoice.pdf. Scanable PDF is preferred (not image-only).
- Holdback: Redwood generally prefers to avoid extended holdbacks at onboarding because it materially impacts cash flow for pilot work. That said, we're open to a compromise: 95% on receipt + 5% holdback for 45 days for the first two pilot invoices only, then standard Net30 after that. If that's acceptable, we can proceed.
- Attached is our standard AP onboarding packet (stello_ap_packet.pdf) and our tax W-9 (redwood_tax_w9.pdf). Please confirm whether you need VAT/EORI fields for EU entities (not applicable here) or an alternate tax form.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the PO number format and holdback cadence (45 days vs 60 days).
2) Jordan will engage with your AP team to exchange remit endpoints and test a sample invoice (we can send a test invoice referencing a dummy PO).
3) Once confirmed, Marissa will approve a one-time pilot payment exception if necessary.

Happy to join a 20-min sync if that helps — mornings PST are easiest.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (628) 555-0107
Attachments: stello_ap_packet.pdf, redwood_tax_w9.pdf

Ben — thanks, that helps. We spoke to AP and here are confirmations: 

- PO format: PO followed by five digits (e.g., PO12345). AP requires this string in both the PDF header and the filename.
- Holdback: Stello policy is 60 days by standard. Procurement can agree to 45 days for first two pilot invoices if Redwood agrees in writing. We'd like that captured in an email thread so AP has an explicit exception note.
- Remit: AP accepts ACH (preferred) or wire. We'll provide the ACH test token when you send the sample invoice.
- Tax: W-9 is fine; AP needs Redwood's EIN (included on the W-9 you attached).

I've attached a sample PO payload (po-sample-stello-9421.pdf) and looped in accounts.payable for the remit test.

Regards,
Marta

Attachment(s): po-sample-stello-9421.pdf
